projectDescription: A character build planner for City of Heroes, part of a community tool suite that also includes Pigg Wrangler (a .pigg archive extractor) and Bin Crawler (a parser for the game's binary data files). Note: this project has over 100 source files; consider scoping analysis to a subdirectory for faster results.
